summary: Verified the 3 confirmed-gap fixes for iteration 8 (targeted scope only, per main-agent instruction). Backend: authored /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_scope.py — 8/8 PASS. Frontend: live UI smoke on the deployed preview URL confirmed all three items. (1) OWNER user-creation dropdown: Users page -> new-user-button opens the Create User modal; the [data-testid=user-role-select] dropdown now lists Owner, Process Owner / Manager, Lead Team, Registration Team, Accounts Team, Dispatch Team, Installation Team, Installation Manager, Installation Member, Complaint Team (all 10 wf.ROLES). Created users with roles INSTALLATION_MANAGER, INSTALLATION_MEMBER, COMPLAINT via POST /api/users -> 200 each; the fresh usernames log in successfully (POST /api/auth/login -> 200). Non-owner (LEAD) POST /api/users -> 403 (backend RBAC enforced; note server also lowercases usernames on create). (2) GET /api/dashboard for the 3 new roles returns exactly the required keys: INSTALLATION_MANAGER -> {awaiting_assignment, install_in_process, pending_acceptance, sv_awaiting, sv_in_process, net_metering}; INSTALLATION_MEMBER -> {sv_assigned, sv_today, sv_completed, ready_to_install, install_in_process, pending_acceptance}; COMPLAINT -> {registered, assigned, in_progress, critical, overdue, due_today}. All values are ints. Frontend dashboards render non-blank: instmgr shows 'Installation Supervision' + 'Site Visit Supervision' stat cards; instmem shows 'My Installations' + 'My Site Visits'; complaint shows 'Complaint Register' cards. (3) COMPLAINT dashboard header shows the [data-testid=dashboard-register-complaint] button; clicking it navigates to /complaints?new=1 and auto-opens the Register Complaint dialog (Title/Description/Category/Priority fields visible). The [data-testid=register-complaint-btn] is also present on the Complaints page header. End-to-end complaint creation succeeded via POST /api/complaints (with title + category_id + priority=MEDIUM) — status returned as REGISTERED and the complaint appears in the subsequent GET /api/complaints list. When no active category exists, OWNER can create one via POST /api/complaint-categories before registering (verified in the E2E test).

POST /api/users lowercases the incoming username; this is not documented in any error message. Front-end should either mirror the lowercase transform on the input or the API should return the canonical username in a 200 response note. Test had to compare uname.lower() to detect it.

Complaint model requires 'title' but the review-request bullet did not mention it; UI Register dialog does surface Title with a * required marker, so functionally fine — just worth calling out in the API contract docs.
